newsitem.title: USA: Hibernia says to merge with Unicorp.
newsitem.headline: Hibernia says to merge with Unicorp.

text.p: Hibernia Corp said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to merge with privately held Unicorp Bancshares-Texas Inc, which operates OrangeBank in Texas.
A Hibernia spokesman said Unicorp shareholders will receive 1.6 shares of Hibernia stock for each share of stock they own.

The exact price of the stock will be determined by the price of Hibernia stock at the close of the deal, but it will be in the range of about $27.6 million in a tax-free pooling of interest, the company said. Hibernia also would assume Unicorp's current outstanding debt.
Hibernia said the merger is expected to close during the fourth quarter.
Hibernia said OrangeBank will change its name to Hibernia National Bank of Texas by the end of the year when its computer system is converted to Hibernia's.
